app.tagline: No employer? Coinvoy gives you what an employer gives.
intro.label: Welcome to Coinvoy
intro.s1Body: Coinvoy is a payroll department for one person: you. Built for Grab, foodpanda and every gig rider in Malaysia.
intro.s2Title: RM900 one week. RM400 the next.
intro.s2Body: 1.64 million Malaysians earn from gig work, and most have no savings to fall back on. Good weeks get spent and slow weeks hurt. We built Coinvoy to change that.
intro.s3Body: Employees get five things riders don't. Coinvoy gives you all five.
intro.s4Body: Coinvoy only works with your own money, in your own bank or e-wallet.
login.pitch: Steady pay, payslips, contributions, paid leave and an advisor. All with your own money.

login.footnote: Your money stays in your own account.

gaji.emptyBody: Snap this week's earnings screen. We'll work out your steady salary.
gaji.step1Body: Screenshot your Grab or foodpanda earnings each week.
gaji.step2Body: We work out a weekly salary you can count on, busy week or slow.
gaji.step3Body: Move the extra into your Buffer pocket. It tops up the slow weeks.
snap.title: Snap
snap.soonBody: Take a screenshot of your Grab or foodpanda earnings.
tabung.title: Pots

tanya.title: Ask
tanya.soonBody: Ask anything about your salary, in your own words.
rekod.title: Records

settings.title: Profile
common.disclaimer: This is an estimate based on your past earnings, not financial advice. The decision is yours.
gaji.estimateLabel: Early estimate: it gets sharper every week you snap.
gaji.why.first: Your first salary, worked out from {n} weeks of earnings.
gaji.why.coldStart: Your first salary. We use an early estimate until there are 4 weeks of data.
gaji.why.bills.up: fewer bills in the next few weeks
gaji.buildUp.label: Buffer
gaji.buildUp.per100: Every RM100 in your buffer raises your salary ~{amount}.
gaji.snapDueBody: Update your earnings so this week's salary is right.
band.title: Your usual earnings
band.summary: A usual week is {mid}. A slow week is around {low}, a busy week around {high}.
jurang.title: Gap
jurang.honest: Things are tight. Your earnings don't cover your basic costs yet, and we won't hide that. Here are your options.
jurang.none: No gap right now. Your safe salary covers your basic costs.
jurang.hoursBody: +{extra} hours a week ({hours} in total) closes this gap (estimate).
jurang.hoursPartial: Even at {hours} hours a week, the safe salary is only {salary}. Hours alone won't close it.
jurang.costsBody: Cutting basic costs by {cut} a week (to {after}) closes the gap. Start with your biggest cost.
jurang.isaraan: i-Saraan Plus: the government adds {rate}% to your EPF contributions, up to {cap} a year (confirm with EPF).
jurang.perkesoDeducted: PERKESO: your platform already deducts it. You're covered if you're hurt while working.
jurang.perkeso: PERKESO: register for SKSPS to be covered if you're hurt while working.
jurang.str: Check if you qualify for government cash aid (such as STR) on the official site.
onb.privacyBody: Before we start, here's how we look after your data.
onb.privacy1: We only use your data for your own salary and features.
onb.privacy2: Screenshots are never stored. We read the numbers, then drop them.
onb.privacy3: We never sell your data, and this isn't a credit score.
onb.privacy4: You can download or delete all your data at any time.
onb.privacyAgree: I agree to the privacy notice
onb.aiAgree: Let AI read my screenshots and answer my questions
onb.aiHint: Processed by an outside AI provider. Without it, you type the numbers yourself.
onb.platformsBody: Pick every app you use. We combine them all.
onb.hoursBody: Your usual hours online. You can change it any time.
onb.fatigue: More than 60 hours a week is tiring and risky on the road. Look after yourself.
onb.payday: Your payday (when you want your weekly salary)
onb.essentialsBody: A rough guess is fine. It tells us if your salary covers what you need.
onb.essentialsHint: Food, rent, fuel, phone, money home. Bills like the motorbike instalment come later.
onb.firstTitle: Let's work out your first salary
onb.firstBody: Snap your last few weeks of earnings (more weeks, sharper salary), or type them in.
snap.body: Screenshot last week's earnings. One screenshot per platform.
snap.historyBody: Pick your weekly earnings screenshots (up to 5 at once). The platform apps keep this history.
snap.privacy: Screenshots aren't stored. We read the numbers, then drop them.
snap.aiOff: AI reading is off in your privacy settings. Type the numbers in.
snap.failed: The image isn't clear. Try again or type it in.
snap.nothingRead: No total could be read. Try another screenshot or type it in.
snap.duplicate: The same platform appears twice in one week.
snap.injection: This image contains odd instructions. Check every number carefully.
snap.warn.grossHigh: That's very high for one week. Is it right?
snap.warn.hoursHigh: Over 100 hours in a week? Please check.
snap.warn.tripsHours: Too many trips for those hours.
snap.warn.fareOdd: The average per trip looks odd. Check the total and trips.
snap.warn.dateFuture: The date on the screenshot is in the future. We set it to last week.
privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.collect: Your Google account name and email, weekly earnings figures, bills, costs and the choices you make in the app.
privacy.why: To work out your own weekly salary, buffer, leave and statement. Nothing else.
privacy.screenshots: Never stored. A screenshot is sent once to be read, then dropped. Location data in the image is removed first.
privacy.keep: Your data is kept while your account is active. Tanya messages are deleted after 90 days. Demo accounts are deleted after 24 hours.
privacy.rights: Download all your data or delete your account at any time in Profile.
privacy.never: Sell your data, lend money, hold your money, or make a credit score.
privacy.ai: Screenshots and Tanya questions are processed by {provider}, in {region}. Only if you allow it.
privacy.aiOff: AI features are off. No data is sent to an AI provider.
